gaps.construct: listeners are functions stored in a registry and returned to callers
gaps.description: The doc has no function type; an opaque invented `Handler` type stands in, so nothing in Scribe says these values can be called.

gaps.construct: typeof evlistener === 'function' to distinguish one listener from an array
gaps.description: No run-time type test. The single-or-array storage trick becomes an explicit `choice EventSlot`, which changes the data representation that the rest of events.js relies on.

gaps.construct: evlistener.listener || evlistener - an ad hoc property attached to a function object by once()
gaps.description: Functions cannot carry properties; the once-wrapper is modelled as a choice variant holding both wrapper and original.

gaps.construct: target._events used as a dictionary keyed by string or Symbol
gaps.description: No map type and no Symbol type in the doc; `Map of EventName to EventSlot` and `lookup name in table` are invented.

gaps.construct: works on any object with an _events property (EventEmitter and all subclasses, plus mixins)
gaps.description: No interfaces or structural typing; restricted to one concrete Emitter type.

gaps.construct: two `=== undefined` checks with early return
gaps.description: Expressible with `maybe`, but each check adds a `choose` level, so a flat 16-line function nests five levels deep. No early-return form like `give back [] if nothing` exists.
Kept as a Bool with an invented label phrase (`unwrapped unwrap`); the doc offers no guidance for naming flag arguments in sentence-style calls.

gaps.construct: returning a fresh array (arrayClone) so callers cannot mutate the registry
gaps.description: The defensive copy matters only because JS arrays are shared mutable references; in Scribe values are not shared, so the copy is semantically a no-op but still allocates and needs an Allocator.

invented_syntax: a maybe Map of ... (maybe around a parameterised type)
label phrase `unwrapped unwrap` for a Bool flag
notes: Event emitters are the canonical adversarial case and Scribe has neither function values nor maps, the two things this function is made of; the translation preserves the shape but every type in it is invented. The nesting cost of `maybe` + `choose` for guard-style early returns is significant: a `when nothing give back` guard form that unwraps into the rest of the body would flatten it.
